VAN:
I Front: q. v.: मुखम्।
II Car: q. v.:
यानम्।

VANDALISM: बार्बरिकत्वम्, -ता: v. Also cruelty,
ferocity.
VANE: वायुदर्शनी and sim. comp. s.

VANISH:
(1) नश्यति, वि- (नश्, c. 4.): v. To
disappear;
(2) पलायते (अय्, c. 1. = fly),
so
long this account will not v.:
तावदिदमाख्यानं न
 पलायिष्यते, H. iv.

VANQUISH: पराजयते (जि, c. 1.): v. To defeat,
conquer.

VANTAGE, VANTAGE GROUND: अग्रभूमिः: v.
Also superiority.
